dog.description_text: Meet Queen Abby! She is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Queen Abby, a 12-year-old female, is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WrzEB6bC0K54pwXmzOQ3JheYDEGJsqAv/view?usp=drive_link Queen Abby is sweet and playful. She is a gorgeous girl who will benefit from being brushed to help her fur remain fluffy and free from matts. Her foster says "After a week she has settled in well: she is relaxed, napping on a chair near us; she eats well. She is a very nocturnal cat and most active at night, wandering around. She is happy to meet new people & get attention from them. Queen Abby is quite settled and very much at home. She's calm, likes being in the same room as people and makes her needs known. She has a calm, demure presence and soft fur. She sits with her paws crossed in front of her." If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Queen Abby! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
